[[File:Final Fantasy Tactics Advance Card Game Collection Card Back.jpg|right|250px|thumb|Card back]]
'''Final Fantasy Tactics Advance Card Game Collection (CGC)''' released in 2003 by Amada Printing.<br>
All cards relate to ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'' and were only available in Japan.<br>
There are a total of 80 single-sided cards split into three categories:
*34 x Character Cards
*40 x Ability Cards
*6 x Law Cards
